name: Moving Checklist
description: Produces a comprehensive 8-week moving timeline and checklist covering decluttering, hiring movers, utilities transfer, address changes, packing strategy, moving day protocol, and first week tasks in the new home. Generates phase-based task lists with specific deadlines and responsible party assignments for household relocations. Use when the user asks about planning a move, creating a moving checklist, or organizing a household relocation. Do NOT use for moving with children specifically (use moving-with-children), international relocation (visa and customs requirements are outside scope), or commercial office moves.
